brief: A privacy-first, Zen-inspired desktop browser built on Helium. It should feel light, calm and private, and stand apart from globes, foxes and swirls.
criteria: Distinct in the browser category, readable at 16 px, works in one colour, says 'helium' without words.

concepts.name: Lift
concepts.idea: A balloon whose shine is a plus: lighter than air, plus more.
rationale: Helium is the gas that lifts balloons
Rounded and calm like the interface

next_steps: Ship as the browser and desktop icon
Professional trademark search before wide use
